objective_value: <float> Twice the total weight of assigned orders minus the total weight of slabs placed into service.
assignments: <list[dict]> Each entry records one order being fulfilled from one slab, with keys 'order' (<int> the order index) and 'slab' (<int> the slab index it is assigned to).
slabs_used: <list[int]> Indices of slabs that are placed into service.
